title: Preferences
objective: Remember the workspace across launches and add the lens switch, mask overlay colour, canvas background, interface size and catalog location to Settings › General.
context_summary: Decided by the owner on 2026-10-04 (docs/decisions.md, Preferences). Preferences live in the host's preferences.json outside every catalog, read and written through preferences.read and preferences.set by every client; the Settings sheet's General tab shows them. The design, with its recorded defaults, is docs/design/preferences.md.

tasks.description: Core preferences: the new typed fields, their checks, preferences.read and preferences.set, the General-field events, the launch read, the lens first-open switch and export.plan's remembered folder.
extra_context: Preferences (crates/luxforge-core/src/preferences.rs) gain auto_lens_profile, mask_overlay_colour, canvas_background, interface_size, catalog, workspace, brush, window and export_folder, each stored only when chosen (absent follows the default) and removed by null. The two existing booleans keep their behaviour and also accept null.
preferences.read answers every field with its default filled in; brush and window answer null until stored. Its schema description and preferences.set's list every field.
A public launch read beside LaunchFlags::resolve gives the desktop the stored catalog, window and interface size before the owner starts, with the reason when the file cannot be read.
EditorService gains the lens switch the owner sets from the preference at start and on preferences.set, as it does auto-collapse; first_open skips the lens module's action when it is off.

acceptance_criteria: Every field round-trips, null resets, and every bad value is refused by name; a malformed or unsupported file is refused without rewriting it.
preferences.set announces only when a General-row field changes.
With auto_lens_profile off an import commits no lens entry; on, it commits it as before.
export.plan suggests <export_folder>/<stem>-edited.jpg, counting up there, only while that folder exists.
The launch read returns the stored catalog, window and interface size, defaults when absent, and the reason when unreadable.

steps: Extend the preference store tests and add owner tests for read, set, refusal and events.
Add a first-open owner test with the switch off and on.
Add export.plan tests with a present and a missing remembered folder.
expected_results: All preference, first-open and export tests pass.

tasks.description: Desktop preference writer and the General tab: one coalescing writer for every preferences.set, the Auto collapse, lens and mask overlay colour rows, the preference evidence step and live application of another client's change.
extra_context: The Performance disclosure and Auto collapse history writes move onto the writer; closing waits for it as it does today.
The mask overlay colour row and the Masks panel's colour control both set this session's colour through workspace.set and store the preference.
The General tab's model holds a row per preference with its own control kind, so the canvas, interface size and catalog rows can be added to it without reshaping it.

context_links.label: Settings state
context_links.relevance: Today's single-field write queue and the General model.

acceptance_criteria: One preferences.set is in flight at a time and later changes merge into one waiting change; close waits for the last.
The General tab shows Auto collapse history, Correct lens distortion on new RAW photos and Mask overlay colour, each showing a change at once.
An evidence step {"preference": {...}} drives the rows' messages and each frame records the preferences applied.
Another client's preferences.set reaches an open sheet and applies the mask overlay colour.

steps: Desktop unit tests for the writer, each row's model and the evidence step.

tasks.description: Remembered workspace, brush and export folder: seed the desktop's session and Masks panel from the stored values at launch and store them as they change.
extra_context: One workspace.set at launch carries the five remembered fields and the mask overlay colour.
Only size, feather and flow of the brush are remembered; a reset stores the neutral value.
The export folder is stored only after a dialog-chosen export succeeds.

context_links.relevance: Remembered workspace, brush and export folder.

context_links.label: Export dialog
context_links.relevance: Where the dialog starts and an export succeeds.

acceptance_criteria: A launch over stored values starts with those panels, overlays, colour and brush.
Toggling a remembered field or changing the brush stores it through the writer.
A dialog-chosen export stores its folder and the next dialog opens there; an evidence-destination export stores nothing.

steps: Desktop unit tests for seeding, storing and the export folder.

tasks.description: Canvas background and interface size: the two General rows and their effects on the canvas colour and the application's scale factor.
extra_context: The canvas colour becomes a parameter of the theme's canvas styles; the three tokens live in luxforge-ui's theme.

Iced's application scale_factor returns the interface size; every physical-pixel computation uses the system factor times it, so 100% stays one source pixel per display pixel. The Settings sheet shrinks to fit a small window.

context_links.label: Scale factor
context_links.relevance: Where the system factor is adopted.

acceptance_criteria: Each canvas choice fills the canvas, the photo surface outside the photograph and the compare canvas, leaving panels and on-black mask modes unchanged.
At each interface size the layout scales, the frame records the combined factor, and at 125% the 100% zoom maps one source pixel to one physical pixel.
Both rows apply at once and on another client's change.

steps: Desktop unit tests for the colour choice, the combined scale factor and 100% mapping at 125%.

tasks.description: Launch preferences: the Catalog row and the catalog location at launch with its missing-folder fallback, and the remembered window frame.
extra_context: Choose Folder… stores <folder>/catalog.sqlite; nothing moves the open catalog. --catalog and evidence runs take precedence.
A stored catalog whose folder is missing opens the default catalog with the status-bar reason; other failures behave as today.

The window frame is stored at close in system points (Iced's logical size times the interface size), not in fullscreen and never by a hidden launch; a frame outside the opening display is centred and shrunk to fit.
acceptance_criteria: A stored catalog opens at the next launch, a new one is created in an empty folder, and the row shows the relaunch and --catalog notes.
A missing folder falls back to the default catalog with the reason and keeps the stored location.
The window opens at its stored frame; --window-size overrides the size; fullscreen and hidden launches store nothing.

steps: Config resolution tests over a stored preferences file, as the developer-flag test does.
Desktop tests for the Catalog row and the window frame stored at close.
